concepts.anchor_rule: Round the midpoint of the supported upright centerline segment to an integer canvas pixel.
concepts.box_rule: Use a half-open box enclosing the supported segment and visible light margins on both sides.
concepts.definition: A locally upright dark band, allowing slight lean, with approximately parallel lateral contours.

negatives.evidence: The supported band runs predominantly horizontally.

positives.evidence: The upper upright segment has light background along both nearly parallel sides.
Above the lower cap, a short, slightly leaning upright shaft has two visible lateral contours.

concepts.support_rule: Require both lateral contours over enough length to establish upright orientation. Exclude crop edges and rounded caps from contour fitting.

concepts.anchor_rule: Round the midpoint of the supported horizontal centerline segment to an integer canvas pixel.
concepts.box_rule: Use a half-open box enclosing the segment and visible light margins above and below.
concepts.definition: A locally horizontal dark band with approximately parallel upper and lower contours.

positives.evidence: A horizontal strip has gently uneven upper and lower boundaries.
A short horizontal section before the bend has visible light above and below.

concepts.support_rule: Require visible upper and lower contours supporting horizontal orientation. Longitudinal cropping supplies no endpoint evidence.

concepts.anchor_rule: Round the midpoint of the supported upward-right centerline segment to an integer canvas pixel.
concepts.box_rule: Use a half-open box enclosing the diagonal segment and visible light margins along both sides.
concepts.definition: A dark band whose supported centerline rises toward the right, allowing uneven contours and varying steepness.

negatives.evidence: The strip bends downward toward the right.

positives.evidence: The thick strip climbs from lower left toward upper right.
Both irregular sides support a steep upward-right progression.
The visible band rises toward the right at a shallower angle.

concepts.support_rule: Require two visible lateral contours and consistent net upward-right progression. Do not infer endpoints at crop edges.

concepts.anchor_rule: Round the intersection of fitted local arm centerlines to an integer canvas pixel.
concepts.box_rule: Use a half-open box enclosing the supported inner turn, short portions of both arms, and adjacent visible light.
concepts.definition: A dark band connecting a leftward arm to a downward arm around a visible light recess below-left. Complete outer-corner rounding is not established.

negatives.evidence: The bend connects an upper arm to a rightward arm, with its recess upper-right.

positives.evidence: A leftward horizontal arm joins a descending arm around a light inner corner below-left.
The leftward arm turns downward around a visible light recess; the outer turn is partly cropped.

concepts.support_rule: Require connected dark arms and a visible inner contour turning around the below-left recess. Cropped outer contours remain unspecified.

concepts.anchor_rule: Round the intersection of fitted local arm centerlines to an integer canvas pixel.
concepts.box_rule: Use a half-open box enclosing the bend, supported arm portions, and visible inner and outer light margins.
concepts.definition: A dark band connecting an upper arm to a rightward arm around a visible upper-right light recess.

negatives.evidence: Its inner recess lies below-left of the bend.

positives.evidence: The upright arm bends right around a clear upper-right light corner.
The descending arm rounds into a rightward section beneath an upper-right light recess.

concepts.support_rule: Require a continuous transition between both arms and a visible upper-right inner recess. Do not infer continuation outside the window.

concepts.anchor_rule: Round the midpoint of the terminal cap across the local shaft direction to an integer canvas pixel.
concepts.box_rule: Use a half-open box enclosing the cap, a short supported shaft portion, and the visible surrounding light.
concepts.definition: A dark shaft terminating downward in a rounded cap with visible light beyond its lower extremity.

negatives.evidence: The descending dark region meets the lower visibility boundary without a visible closing cap.

positives.evidence: The lower shaft closes in a rounded cap with clear light beneath it.
The descending arm closes in a rounded lower cap with a narrow light margin beneath.

concepts.support_rule: Require a continuous closing contour joining both shaft sides and visible light below the cap. A crop boundary cannot establish termination.
